# auditor

> auditor is a family of PHP packages for audit logs: auditor (provider-agnostic core), auditor-doctrine-provider (Doctrine ORM change tracking and audit tables) and auditor-bundle (Symfony integration and audit viewer, formerly DoctrineAuditBundle).

Symfony applications install damienharper/auditor-bundle; Doctrine ORM applications without Symfony install damienharper/auditor-doctrine-provider; damienharper/auditor alone is the core. These docs describe the latest line of each package; older lines are listed on the site.
